mentions.title: King Bearings Quality?
mentions.snippet: Mopar forum thread reporting a 2024 King main bearing out of spec on free spread and a 2025 main also found bad, with builders raising spun-bearing risk. Contested in-thread by others who report no problems since 2024.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread telling owners to measure and inspect every King bearing before installation. Framed as a general quality-control alarm, not a single bad set.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch failed with connection refused (ECONNREFUSED) on the e90post host; thread could not be read.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on a diesel truck forum about King main thrust bearings. Titled as a warning to other builders rather than a support question.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: King STDX thrust bearings reported over 1mm too narrow to fit across multiple BMW S85 and S65 blocks. Poster went back for a refund and said they would not use King again.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Complaint combining a mis-packed bearing set (mixed .011 and .030 shells) with dissatisfaction over the support response. Service complaint as much as a product one.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: One King SI main shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted roughly 1/8" out of size and unusable. Rod bearings also arrived with bearing shaving material and oil in the shrink wrap.
